page.overview:
Who is Hagarg Ryonis?

Hagarg Ryonis, also known as The Lier-in-Wait, is a fictional entity created by Sandy Petersen for the Call of Cthulhu gaming supplement H. P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands.

Hagarg Ryonis is one of the Great Ones, the gods of Earth that reside in Kadath. She appears as a huge reptilian monster with black scales, six irregularly spaced eyes, and obsidian claws and teeth.

Although Hagarg Ryonis is not evil, when the unbelief and depravity of Dreamland’s inhabitants become so severe that they disturb the emotions of the Great Ones, she carries out a massacre until the people repent. (: H. P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands)

In Hyperborea, Hagarg Ryonis was regarded as the guardian of tombs and homes, meting out justice to the unjust. (: Wizards of Hyperborea)
